|strategy=By Tim Lau<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/duallasercannon.html</ref>

Are you like me, always having trouble taking out Walkers? Well look no furthur, this may not win every battle, but it sure makes the Dark Side think twice about Walkers. Use Dual Laser Cannons in combination with a [[Power Harpoon]]. Trip the Walker with the harpoon, now that the Walker's armor is 2, use Dual Lasers to finish it off. This method works well because the Dark Side has to lose everyone that is on board, and they might have trouble mounting an effective second strike. If they no longer have Walkers, use the [[Dual Laser Cannon]], preferably on [[Rogue 1]] or 3 with matching gunners, to shoot people who are camping outside.
